title: Tree-Level Interaction Vertices in the Linear Sigma Model with Quarks under Global Rotation
summary: We derive the tree-level interaction vertices of the linear sigma model with quarks in the presence of global rotation. Starting from the scalar and fermionic field solutions in a rotating background, we construct the corresponding spectral representations and use them to evaluate the mesonic self-interactions and Yukawa couplings of the model.
